01. PROBLEM STATEMENT & SPESIFIKASI SUMBER DATA

📡 Sumber Streaming (Real-Time)
• Provider: OpenSky Network Live API
• Sifat: High-velocity state vectors (~150 pesawat/poll)
• Frekuensi: Interval polling 15 detik
• Atribut Kunci: icao24, callsign, lat, lon, baro_altitude, ground velocity, vertical_rate
• Identifier: event_id hash SHA-256 (F-04/F-05)

🗄️ Sumber Batch (Terjadwal & Historis)
• Provider: OurAirports Master Dataset (Public Domain)
• Volume: 5.282 bandara komersial aktif global
• Skema: ident (ICAO), iata_code, nama bandara, koordinat (lat/lon), elevasi, iso_country
• Format: Parquet / ACID Table dengan batch_id unik (F-02)
• Fungsi: Join enrichment & feature grounding ML
Menjelaskan pemenuhan syarat 1 sumber streaming dan 1 sumber batch yang legal dan saling melengkapi.
02. ARSITEKTUR PIPELINE: MEDALLION & STREAM BROKER

🥉 BRONZE (RAW)

• Broker: Redpanda (Kafka-compatible C++, ramah RAM ~512MB)
• Topic: flight-raw-stream
• Ingestion: stream_producer.py memisahkan event_time vs ingest_time
• Storage: Raw payload JSON disimpan untuk audit & replay

🥈 SILVER (VALIDATED)

• Quality Gate (F-08): Null check koordinat (-90 s/d 90, -180 s/d 180)
• Deduplikasi: In-memory/Redis filter hash event_id unik (F-05)
• DLQ (Dead Letter Queue): Isolasi anomali sensor
• Table ACID: silver.flight_states di PostgreSQL

🥇 GOLD (CURATED)

• Geospasial Haversine: Perhitungan jarak sisa pesawat ke bandara terdekat
• Marts Siap Saji: gold.active_flights_mart & density
• Feature Store ML: Jarak, velocity, altitude, jam operasi
• Format Analitik: Parquet terkompresi
Arsitektur Medallion Bronze-Silver-Gold memenuhi F-06, F-07, dan F-08.
03. DESAIN EKSPERIMEN & RETRAINING MACHINE LEARNING
Target Prediksi: Estimasi Delay Kedatangan (arrival_delay_min) | Fixed Test Set (Seed: 42, No Data Leakage)

Eksperimen 1: Baseline (v1)
• Algoritma: Ridge Regression (Alpha: 1.0)
• Sifat: Linear Model Baseline
• Metrik Evaluasi:
  - MAE : 5.14 menit
  - RMSE : 6.62 menit
  - R² Score : 0.1686
• Status: Baseline benchmark awal

Eksperimen 2: Retrained Candidate (v2)
• Algoritma: RandomForestRegressor (Estimator: 100, Depth: 8)
• Sifat: Non-linear Ensemble Learning
• Metrik Evaluasi:
  - MAE : 3.27 menit
  - RMSE : 4.04 menit
  - R² Score : 0.6894
• Hasil: Peningkatan Akurasi 38.88% (Promoted ke Production!)
Memenuhi F-11 & F-12: Eksperimen model, versioning, dan pembuktian retraining kandidat model.
04. SERVING LAYER (FASTAPI) & REACT COCKPIT DASHBOARD

⚡ FastAPI Serving Endpoints (F-10/F-12)

• GET /api/v1/health : Status kontainer & model
• GET /api/v1/flights/active : Query 50 mart pesawat aktif
• GET /api/v1/airports/{code} : Lookup bandara
• POST /api/v1/ml/predict-delay : Online inference return score, predicted_at, model_version
• GET /api/v1/ml/experiments : Log versioning

🖥️ React Professional Dashboard (F-13)

• Modern Stack: React + Vite + Lucide Icons
• Live Telemetry Radar: Polling stream 15 detik
• 4 KPI Cards: Total Pesawat, Rata-rata Delay, Kecepatan, dan Ketinggian
• Model Playground: Form interaktif uji inference delay secara live di layar
• Search & Filter: Filter jam & pencarian bandara
Menampilkan serving mart dan implementasi dashboard profesional React.
